about.title: Software delivered end to end.
about.body: Soft Step delivers software for businesses that need reliable backends, e-commerce, and web platforms. Work spans Django and NestJS APIs, WordPress and WooCommerce sites, and React frontends — including realtime marketplaces, store integrations, and ongoing site maintenance. The projects below reflect production systems Soft Step has delivered.

indoform.name: IndoForm — WhatsApp Commerce Platform for UMKM
indoform.tagline: Your online store, one link away.
indoform.desc: Soft Step's flagship platform for Indonesian UMKM: a WhatsApp-first storefront where merchants create a shop, share a private link, and receive orders directly on WhatsApp — with QRIS payments, a vendor dashboard, and zero platform commission.
indoform.role: End-to-end delivery of Soft Step's own UMKM commerce platform — backend, dashboard, storefront and payments.
features: Private, shareable storefront link for every merchant
WhatsApp-native order flow — customers checkout in ~10 seconds
QRIS integration for local Indonesian payments
Vendor dashboard: orders, statuses and tracking numbers
0% platform commission — merchants keep their revenue
Scalable API architecture and realtime order tracking

valleyOrder.role: Backend, API and realtime systems delivery for a multi-role marketplace.
features: Production API for Customer / Provider / Captain / Admin
Hybrid live GPS tracking with a NestJS Socket.io sidecar sharing JWT and Postgres
